'''Clan Onel''' was a clan of [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]],<ref name="GCG">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> which included the [[Im family]]. [[Tresk Im'nel]] was a notable member of this clan. A member of the [[Bothan Diplomatic Corps]], he later became a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] in the [[New Jedi Order]].<ref name="wotc">{{Wizards|url=starwars/article.asp?x=npc_tresk|text=Tresk Im'nel, Bothan Noble}}</ref>
